description: A sequencer built on an ancestral tree: a cursor travels through a random genealogy, and the mutations each sample has inherited at that moment become a polyphonic chord.

params.text: Sets the internal traversal speed, -6 to +5 octaves around a tenth of a complete tree per second; the centre takes about 10 seconds to cross one tree.
Sets how many samples the next tree is generated with, 2 to 16, which is also the number of channels TRAITS puts out.
Sets the expected total number of mutations on the next tree, 0 to 64.
Sets how much voltage each inherited mutation adds to a sample's trait, 0 to 12 semitones; it changes the current tree at once rather than waiting for a new one.
Chooses Ancestry, travelling back from the present toward the common ancestor, or Descent, travelling forward from the ancestor; switching it reverses the movement from where the cursor already is.
Sets whether the cursor jumps back to the start after reaching the end of its direction, or stops there until a new tree, a replay or a change of direction moves it.
Generates a new tree from the current SAMPLES and MUTATE settings, with new topology, branch timings, mutation placements and signs.
Replays the current tree from the start of the chosen direction, without changing the topology or the mutations, so the replay is exact.

inputs.text: Adds to the RATE knob at 1V per octave; the two together are clamped to -12 through +5 octaves, giving at most 3.2 complete trees a second.
Sets the cursor's position through the tree absolutely, 0V at the sampled present and 10V at the common ancestor; while a cable is here the rate and loop controls no longer move it.
A rising edge past 1V generates a new tree, the same operation as the NEW button.
A rising edge past 1V replays the current tree, the same operation as the RESET button.

outputs.text: One channel per sample carrying the signed sum of the mutations that sample has inherited at the cursor's position, at a twelfth of the STEP setting in volts per mutation.
A 10V pulse 1ms long when the cursor crosses one or more coalescent nodes, the root included.
A 10V pulse 1ms long when the cursor crosses one or more mutation positions.
A 10V pulse 1ms long on arrival at the common ancestor, or on starting a descent there.
The number of distinct ancestral lineages at the cursor's position, mapped to 10V at the sampled present and 0V at the common ancestor.
The mean pairwise number of inherited mutations between samples, at 2V per mutation and clamped at 10V; the STEP setting does not change it.

notes: SAMPLES and MUTATE describe the next tree, not the one playing. Moving either off the values the current tree was made with lights the yellow lamp beside NEW; pressing NEW clears it.
With nothing patched to TIME the cursor is driven by RATE. Patching a cable there takes the cursor over at the input voltage, and unpatching hands it back to the internal transport.
Rack's Initialize is not the panel RESET: it restores every parameter to its default and then generates a fresh tree, where RESET replays the tree already loaded.
At the common ancestor every TRAITS channel and the diversity output are exactly zero, because no mutation has happened yet.
